chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man, late 20s, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman, mid 20s, wearing a light pink hijab and a long lilac modern dress with white sneakers
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her late 50s, wearing a white headscarf and a dark green house caftan with a striped apron

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a cosy Moroccan living room with low sedari couches, WIFE casually hands her smartphone to NARRATOR; NARRATOR holds it with a surprised raised eyebrow, she smiles and turns away. Both faces visible, head-to-waist, centred.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan kitchen with blue zellige tiles, MOM calls NARRATOR to help her lift a big pot; NARRATOR stands next to her holding a smartphone in one hand, glancing at it. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of NARRATOR in a Moroccan hallway staring at a smartphone screen with wide shocked eyes and open mouth, the glow of the screen on his face. The screen faces away from the viewer. Face centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR scrolling fast on a smartphone with his thumb, jaw dropped, sweat drop on his forehead, standing by a window in a Moroccan apartment, comic exaggerated disbelief. Screen faces away. Face centred.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A traditional Moroccan street cafe with small round metal tables and glasses of mint tea; NARRATOR sits alone at a table, leaning forward, watching his smartphone intensely, older men in the background blurred. Face visible, centred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room, WIFE stands in front of a smartphone mounted on a tripod with a ring light, posing confidently and talking to the camera like an influencer, big smile. Head-to-waist, face visible, centred.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: WIFE dancing joyfully in a Moroccan living room in front of a smartphone on a tripod, arms raised, a small speaker on the coffee table, playful comic energy. Face visible, centred, full figure.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: WIFE sitting on a sedari couch facing a smartphone on a tripod, wagging her finger and explaining with a serious know-it-all expression, like giving marriage advice to an audience. Face visible, head-to-waist, centred.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan street cafe, NARRATOR facepalms with one hand while holding his phone in the other, while two men at the next table laugh loudly at their own phones. NARRATOR in the centre, faces visible.
